title: Reader chrome auto-hides too quickly for real settings interaction
symptom: The reader controls disappeared before users could comfortably inspect settings, TOC, or chapter actions.
root_cause: The auto-hide timing was tuned for minimum chrome exposure instead of the slower rhythm of actual reading adjustments.
fix: Extended the auto-hide timeout to around 3 seconds.
Kept interaction-heavy states such as settings expansion from collapsing immediately.
impact: Users had to re-open controls repeatedly, which made the reader feel twitchy and harder to operate.
